INSERT INTO email_contact_address_book_projection(contact_id,previous_name,applied_name,previous_photo,applied_photo)
            VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5) ON CONFLICT(contact_id) DO UPDATE SET previous_name = EXCLUDED.previous_name,applied_name = EXCLUDED.applied_name,
                previous_photo = EXCLUDED.previous_photo,applied_photo = EXCLUDED.applied_photo
